name: smwmusic-the-battle-of-olympus-enter-your-name-password-screen
title: The Battle of Olympus - Enter Your Name / Password Screen
description:
Mysterious-sounding track that would probably best fit night, underground or spacey overworlds. Marked as a remix since it has drums and more stuff compared to the original.

Credits - Thanks to:
- Epcudo on MuseScore for their transcription which meant I didn't have to transcribe it by ear
- TsugiEdgi on YouTube for their remix from which I adapted part of this port.
- Kazuo Sawa for composing the original NES track.
